articles.title: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
articles.summary: Fifa strongly criticises what it calls a "concerted and ongoing effort" to "undermine" the organisation and its president Gianni Infantino.

articles.title: Five-time Super League winner Makinson to retire at end of 2026 campaign
articles.summary: Tommy Makinson has announced he will retire from rugby league at the end of the current 2026 Super League campaign.

articles.title: Sinner withdraws from Cincinnati Open as knee injury raises US Open fears
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the Cincinnati Open with an injury to his right knee.
